description: Model-seed robustness (Section 9). Three independently trained QAT-PO2 weight sets (seeds 42/43/44), same 8/16/24/7 architecture, routed with the frozen final HLS architecture (A4/Final masks) and the validated SSI_SpreadLogic_high + retime physical strategy. This is the 'common mask, unmodified' variant: no per-seed guided DSP/pipeline remap was performed (Section 9.1 steps 6-7 were skipped) -- it tests whether the nominal-model configuration transfers as-is, not whether a re-derived mapping is required per seed.
